attention4.ptxt: Applying a shock to the catalytic converter with GPF may cause damage to the inside the catalyst.
Handle the catalytic converter with GPF carefully not to drop it or hit it against something.

s1.ptxt: Remove A/F sensor and HO2S from catalytic converter with GPF.
Disconnect GPF pressure No.1 hose (1) and No.2 hose (2) from catalytic converter with GPF.
Remove EGR exhaust side pipe (1) with gaskets.
Remove catalytic converter cover bolts and move the cover (1) until turbocharger outlet clamp bolt (2) becomes accessible.
Remove exhaust pipe bolts (1) from exhaust pipe.
Remove catalytic converter No.1 stiffener (2) and No.2 stiffener (3).
Remove catalytic converter with GPF together with the converter cover from turbocharger.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Use new gaskets and seal ring.
Install catalytic converter with GPF and its stiffeners as follows.
Install gasket (1) to turbocharger.
Set catalytic converter with GPF (2) together with catalytic converter cover.
Put mating ends of turbocharger outlet clamp (1), and tighten the bolt temporarily by hand.
Install catalytic converter No.1 stiffener (1) and No.2 stiffener (2), and tighten these bolts and nut temporarily by hand.
Put mating ends of turbocharger outlet clamp (1) at specified angle as shown.
Tighten turbocharger outlet clamp bolt (2) to specified torque and check that clamp ends (3) touch each other.
If not, loosen the clamp, adjust the positioning and tighten it again.
Tighten catalytic converter stiffener bolts (1) and nut (2) in numerical order (“1” – “4”) to specified torque.
Tighten exhaust pipe bolts (3) to specified torque.
Tighten catalytic converter cover bolts (1) to specified torque.
Install EGR exhaust side pipe (1) as follows.
Set EGR exhaust side pipe gaskets (2) as shown in figure.
Tighten EGR exhaust side pipe bolts (4) temporarily by hand.
Tighten EGR exhaust side pipe bolts (3) and (4) in numerical order (“1” – “2”) securely.
Run engine and check for exhaust gas leakage.
After replacing catalytic converter with GPF with new one, perform the following procedure.
With ignition “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC.
Set ignition “ON”.
Execute “Initialize GPF data” in “Utility” menu following instructions displayed on SUZUKI scan tool.
Set ignition “OFF” and disconnect SUZUKI scan tool from DLC.
